content.bridge_context: Diving deeper into number theory by focusing on the 'building blocks' of numbers: Primes.

units.title: Primes vs. Composites
units.explanation: Every whole number greater than 1 is either prime or can be made by multiplying primes.
units.dual_language_instruction: List primes up to 10. (2, 3, 5, 7). / 10 तक की अभाज्य संख्याएँ लिखें।

units.title: Prime Factorization
units.explanation: Breaking a number down into its prime components.
units.dual_language_instruction: Break 12 into primes: 2 x 2 x 3. / 12 को अभाज्य गुणनखंडों में तोड़ें।
